crm_notes: Shorthand: Anders (eng lead) cares most about reranker latency + deterministic recall on code.
detailed_requirements:
- Corpus size: currently ~3M files, expected growth to 20-30M files within 12 months.
- Embedding counts: 25M+ vectors, avg dim 768 but evaluating 512/1024 options.
- Re-index cadence: nightly full index for codebase; per-PR incremental indexing desired (near-real-time for hot repos).
- Query load: target 150-250 QPS peak, 20k-40k queries/hour.
- Latency SLO: 95th pct <= 200ms for search+rerank (ideal), acceptable up to 350ms during heavy load.
- Cost target: <= $0.005 per query (including retrieval + rerank compute).
- Model preferences: open LLMs for rerank (Llama alt), quantized runners; customer open to Redwood model catalog variants.
- Rerank requirement: compute-aware fallback to cheaper reranker when latency spike; policy controls needed.
- Security: SAML SSO, enterprise SCIM, tenant isolation, KMS-backed keying, E2E audit logs, retention policy controls, data residency in NA/EU.
poc_scope: 1) Index 3M file snapshot into embeddings store; 2) Run hybrid retrieval (BM25 + ANN) with learned reranker; 3) Measure 95p latency with 128-token rerank; 4) Validate incremental indexing (per-PR pipeline) and TTL/retention policies.

technical_risks: Index churn: frequent re-indexing of code causes vector drift and cache invalidations. Cost risk: rerank compute at 200 QPS can dominate TCO. Networking: customer on-prem connectors may require air-gapped deployment path for some repos.
